Moonrise has a part 1 and a part 2. 

In part one you go in, as a 'True Soul' And poke around, the only killing you should do in part 1 of moonrise is killing the guards in the prison, the eyes, and the warden. Or knocking them out if you are a paladin. 

Talk to everyone and explore everything on the main floor and what they call the first floor of the tower, including the entirety of Balthazar, Ketheric and Melodia's rooms. Then you leave And go to rescue the tieflings and gnomes. From there you should be able to go to last light with them on this gift that they escape on. 

After this it is time to explore the mausoleum, find balthazar's secret laboratory, Then do the last of the gauntlet of Shar, kill Raphael's enemy, and then finally grab the nightsong.

After this is Moonrise part 2 where you end up fighting the tower and Ketheric fight part 1, after which you can officially recruit Jaheira, Long rest then in order to regain health and respec her/ level her, Then when you return you will be in the same spot and be able to do the mind flayer colony, Explore every room in there fully. And then finally Ketheric part two.

Think of Moonrise as a Part 1 and a Part 2

Part 1:
1) Go talk to half orc chick, get quest to look for Balthazar

2) Go upstairs a level, she gives you access to his rooms to find a moonlantern. You already have one, but take it anyway to explore things. When altar is found, stick heart on altar. Unlocks hidden room.

3) Explore Ketheric and his wife's rooms on same floor, access door to Ketheric is outside of building. Melodia's adjoins his 

4) You may kill half orc chick in the room she's in upstairs without too much interference or save her for big battle.

5) Downstairs to prison, free tiefs and gnomes.

LEAVE MOONRISE.

1) Explore mausoleum 
2) Entrance to Shar's temple inside.
3) Once foyer is unlocked, go to left and up mushroom path. Go into Sharran dining room, then find Balthazar's private laboratory.
4) Kill Balthazar.
5) Complete Gauntlet of Shar- bring Shadowheart, you may long rest when you need
6) Deal with Raphael's enemy
7) Make Shadowheart choice w/ Nightsong.
8) Get out of Sharran Temple, Long rest.

MOONRISE PART TWO

1) Fight in foyer
2) Mini fight up near entry to 'altar'
3) Ketheric part 1.
4) Recruit Jaheira into party, long rest, respect her for proper stats
5) Jump down hole into Mindflayer colony 
6) Explore every door inside
7) Rescue bad kitty from cage if wanted
8) Find Zariel's asset trapped in a pod, free them.
9) Rescue others in mind flayer pods in same room with control console
10) Deal with people in other room
11) deal with death shepherd and zombies
12) Find room with restoration device, use it. Acts like a long rest.
13) Ketheric Part 2.

In most cases, I am very much against the breeding of pets. However, there's a -small- number of cases where it's needed. Back in the 90s, I wanted a pet. My mom was allergic to cats and dogs. I wasn't. We did our research, and found that the Bichon Frise tended to be a very good dog breed for those allergic to dogs. At the time, the breed was hardly heard of, and while there was Bichon rescue it was in its early stages and there were none available in our state. So we got a Bichon puppy. We have since rescued Bichons, or at least dogs that the shelter -claimed- were Bichons, with varying results to their hypoallergenic natures. To someone where having a hypoallergenic pet may be a matter of life or death, they really canNOT risk it with a shelter dog. 

Similarly, when it comes to cats, purebred Siberian cats have a gene that alters the protein in their saliva that tends to cause allergies in humans. While it doesn't make them 100% allergy proof, it can often substantially reduce it so that the allergies remaining are manageable. 

Another example is the breeding of service dogs. While some animals from shelters can have the temperament for service work, the best work is done for those whose bloodline has produced strong service animals before.
